reviewer: root source and logical implication review
reason: An operation need not explicitly name its result within two fields. Result mention can be implicit, delayed, conditional or at another record; matched opaque/material controls are not guaranteed semantic negatives. The75percent/15point rule adds an overt-local-result convention. No semantic test selected. GDT702 supplies an inherited occurrence-bound relation; GDT703/705/706/707/708/709 already expand this lineage. GDT763 concerns a different pcheey result candidate and is not the direct successor or a general operation-latency disproof.

blockers.detail: Given independently warranted field boundaries/types and a separately motivated overt-result convention, test the fixed short-latency compound model. Failure then concerns that conjunction, not operation meaning alone.
A concrete target and independently justified mapping/encoding assumptions that make a contrary result change a meaningful research decision; no automatic relaxed thresholds or new control corpus.
